name: Li Qingzhao
shortBio: Song-dynasty Chinese philosopher of aesthetics, epigrapher, and ci poet whose Treatise on Ci Poetry (Cilun) formulated rigorous formal principles of musical-linguistic harmony while asserting female scholarly parity.
centralQuestion: How do sonic cadence, emotional sincerity, and historical memory synthesize into an autonomous aesthetics beyond orthodox Confucian didacticism?

keyWorks.title: Treatise on Ci Poetry (Cìlùn)
keyWorks.description: Pioneering aesthetic theory distinguishing lyric ci poetics as a distinct, rule-governed philosophical art form ("biejia").

keyWorks.title: Afterword to Jinshi Lu (Records on Metal and Stone)
keyWorks.description: Philosophical memoir reflecting on impermanence, material culture, and textual preservation amid dynastic collapse.
